user.title: Set up Ogg
user.description: Add the local server addresses Ogg should try. Setup works while every server is offline. Turn on the Enabled switch when ready. Connecting never starts a device.

data.ssl: Use a secure connection by default
data.multi_server: Connect to two servers at once (beta)

data_description.manual_hosts: Up to five IP addresses, hostnames, or full ws:// / wss:// URLs. Leave empty when using address sensors only. These are alternative servers; one is connected at a time.
data_description.sensor_entities: Up to five sensors whose state is an IP address, hostname, or WebSocket URL. Unavailable or invalid states are skipped until they become valid.
data_description.port: Used when an address does not include its own port.
data_description.ssl: Uses wss:// for addresses without an explicit scheme. Certificate verification stays enabled.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between checks when disconnected and between device scans while connected.
data_description.multi_server: Keep the first address (for example this Home Assistant's IntiHA) and one other reachable address (for example your phone) connected together. Devices from both appear as one list. Off: only one server is connected at a time.

error.invalid_config: Check the addresses and sensors. Use no more than five of each, a valid port, and a search interval from 5 to 120 seconds.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Ogg is already configured. Use Configure on the existing integration to change its addresses.

studio.title: Studio privacy and PIN
studio.description: A PIN is {pin}. It locks the OggStudio cards, not Home Assistant.

data.no_history: Keep Ogg and OggStudio out of history and the logbook

data_description.no_history: Clears what the recorder kept about these entities, at start and every half hour. To have nothing written at all, also exclude them in configuration.yaml (see the README).
data_description.discreet: Cards open covered, with a neutral title, no device names and no version line.
data_description.discreet_name: The title shown on a discreet or locked card.
data_description.users: Leave empty for everyone. Others do not see the cards and cannot call OggStudio's services. Stopping always works.
data_description.pin: 4 to 32 characters. Leave empty to keep the current one.
data_description.auto_lock: 0 keeps a card unlocked until the browser tab closes.

hold.name: Hold to run
hold.description: Run a device while this is called repeatedly; it stops by itself shortly after the last call.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

motor.name: Motor
motor.description: 1 or 2 for one motor of a two-motor device; omit for all motors.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to keep running after this call (0.3-3 s).

live.name: Live levels
live.description: Set live motor levels (sliders); stops by itself shortly after the last call.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: One level 0-1 per motor, e.g. [0.5] or [0.3, 0.8].

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to keep these levels after this call (0.3-3 s).

linear.name: Live linear move
linear.description: Move a stroker (e.g. The Handy, Launch, Keon) to a position over a duration, without stopping first. For live following; a newer call replaces one still waiting.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

play_script.description: Play a funscript timeline (pos 0-100 = intensity) on a device.

entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

script.name: Script
script.description: Funscript object; optional second motor in channels.V1.

output.name: Output
output.description: Vibrate (motors), Linear (a stroker follows the positions) or Auto (a stroker when the device has no motors).

max_seconds.name: Time limit
max_seconds.description: Stop after this many seconds, even when looping.

stop_script.name: Stop script
stop_script.description: Stop script playback (or any output) on a device.

entity_id.name: Device entity
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

studio_save.name: Save script
studio_save.description: Save a funscript under a name (overwrites a script with the same name).

script.name: Script
script.description: Funscript object (pos 0-100; optional channels.V1 for motor 2). metadata.type 'stroke' marks a stroke script, converted to vibration when played.

mode.name: Run mode
mode.description: Stroke scripts only: how position becomes vibration. speed, position, upper (position above 50%: 50% and below off, 75% = half power), combo (speed plus position), down (speed on downstrokes only) or up (upstrokes only).

studio_play.name: Play script
studio_play.description: Play a saved script (or a given script) on an Ogg device.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

name.name: Name
name.description: Saved script; defaults to the selected one.

script.name: Script
script.description: Play this funscript without saving it.

mode.name: Run mode
mode.description: Stroke scripts only: how position becomes vibration. speed, position, upper (position above 50%: 50% and below off, 75% = half power), combo (speed plus position), down (speed on downstrokes only) or up (upstrokes only). Defaults to the mode last used for the script; giving one remembers it.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

studio_set_mode.name: Set run mode
studio_set_mode.description: Remember how a saved stroke script is converted to vibration.

studio_claim.name: Claim live control
studio_claim.description: Used by the Ogg Studio cards so only one phone or browser drives a device live at a time. Lapses after 12 seconds unless refreshed.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: An id for the controlling card.

label.name: Label
label.description: Shown to other controllers, for example "Shane on Android".

studio_panic.name: Stop everything
studio_panic.description: Stop every Ogg device now, drop all live control and halt every open Ogg Studio card. Never refused.

studio_set_limits.name: Set device limits
studio_set_limits.description: Limits nothing in Ogg Studio goes past on a device: scripts, live control, moods, audio and a remote partner.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

max.name: Top intensity
max.description: Percent of full power (100 = no limit).

speed.name: Top stroke speed
speed.description: Percent of full speed (100 = no limit).

studio_save_playlist.name: Save playlist
studio_save_playlist.description: Save a queue of saved scripts and moods under a name.

items.name: Items
items.description: A list, in order, of {script: name} and {mood: key}.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Start again after the last item.

oggstudio_merged.title: OggStudio is now part of Ogg
oggstudio_merged.description: The Play card, your saved scripts, limits and privacy settings now live in Ogg. Remove the OggStudio integration (Settings > Devices & services > OggStudio > Delete) and, in HACS, remove OggStudio. Your dashboards keep working: the cards are the same.
